decision.reasoning_trace: The consideration set focuses on well-rated, portable speakers across different price points. The JBL Charge 5 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_120) is the premium option but is significantly more expensive at nearly $150. The Altec Lansing (prod_bluetooth_speakers_045) is a reliable budget choice, but the Raymate (prod_bluetooth_speakers_153) and Comiso (prod_bluetooth_speakers_173) offer a better balance of power and value. I chose the Raymate because it offers 30W of HiFi sound and has an excellent 4.6 rating with positive feedback on its heft and sound quality, representing the best performance-for-price value in the set.
